errors.text_span: Die x-Achse repräsentiert die Jahre von 2000 bis 2022
errors.evidence: The x-axis labels clearly show a range from 2000 to 2020. While the data extends slightly beyond 2020, stating the axis represents years up to 2022 is incorrect.
For the green line (Austria), the first peak occurs around 2004, not 2003, and the value is closer to 0.65%, not 0.60%.
For the green line (Austria), the value in 2006 is approximately 0.3%. The line reaches a low of 0.25% around the year 2009/2010, not 2006.

errors.evidence: For the green line (Austria), the peak in 2015 is at approximately 1.30%, not 1.40%.
For the green line (Austria), the value in 2016 is significantly higher than 0.50%; it is closer to 0.85%. The line reaches approximately 0.50% around the year 2020.

errors.text_span: steigt schließlich auf etwa 1,50 % im Jahr 2022
errors.evidence: The year 2022 cannot be determined from the chart's x-axis, which ends at 2020. Stating the year is 2022 is a hallucination.
For the blue line (Germany), the lowest point is reached around 2009, not 2008. The value in 2008 is closer to -0.05%.
